snippet.title: Erosion - Playtest Trailer | June 23 first public playtest
snippet.description:
Sign up for the first playable version of Erosion on Steam, starting June 23!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3211720

Discord: https://discord.gg/Erosion

Erosion will launch in early 2027. 

If your daughter was kidnapped, you would do anything to find her. Erosion challenges you to blast through voxel dungeons and vanquish epic arcade-inspired bosses, at least until your hearts run out. When they do, you’ll find that your daughter and everything else in the world you once knew are 10 years older. As time skips forward with every respawn, how old will she be when you finally reach her? Dive deeper into the dungeon by exploring an open neon-west overworld, completing quests, unlocking new gear, and choosing your fated timelines along the way. It's what you must do to save your daughter and save the world.

Music - "Hey It's Alright" by Lewis Andrew, Chris Potter and Dominic Heneghan
